name: Sephirah Da'at
source: The protagonist of the story, an artificial intelligence that has recently begins their work as an android, with both bold and humble personalities. They have no specific gender and can change their appearance depending on the situation. An old-fashioned type, they are fond of 20th century films and other entertainment works.
